{{Quote|All other hull plating is a duranium&ndash;kathor composite, capable of withstanding up to 75 Gs without alluvial dampening affects.|The [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-D20]] describes the ''Helix''-class light interceptor|<ref name="ABGTAS" />}}
'''Kathor''' was a substance used in [[Starship/Legends|starship]] manufacturing. A kathor&ndash;[[Duranium/Legends|duranium]] composite was used to make the majority of the [[Hull/Legends|hull]] plating on [[Helix-class light interceptor|''Helix''-class light interceptors]], which were vessels designed and made by starship manufacturer [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]]. The plating was capable of withstanding seventy&ndash;five Gs without [[Alluvial damper/Legends|alluvial dampening]] affects.<ref name="ABGTAS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kathor was mentioned in [[1995]] in the article "[[A Buyer's Guide to Alternative Starships]]," which was published in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 5|fifth]] issue of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' series of supplement books for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' by [[West End Games]]. The article was written by [[Stephen Luminati]].<ref name="ABGTAS" />
